title: internal how-to notes are published to Read the Docs
author: Claude-JG
description: docs/howTo/ holds notes of two kinds: what a USER needs (building from source, conda environments) and what only a maintainer needs (converting videos with ffmpeg, matplotlib recipes, Visual Studio 2022, build quirks, what MSVC accepts where gcc does not). All of them are in the toctree and are published. The second kind should stay in the repository and be mentioned in one line - "further notes are in the repository" with a link - rather than being part of the manual. The mechanism is exclude_patterns in conf.py, which already excludes docs/revision/ and .github/.
